scores.tell: Crystal ball edges are soft and outline-free, but the golden stand has crisp, slightly hard rims and the checker background is sharp.

none. The hat has smooth soft edges with no outline, and the brim edge is clean.
The candelabra has glowing halos around the flames and sharp specular rims on the gold, and the ray background is hard-edged.

The topiary is dense with many leaf edges everywhere. The background has a lot of detail, the paving and hedge edges are all equally crisp, and there is no edge hierarchy.
